mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.3 percentage points signals improved labor market confidence, which raises consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and confidence, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST declines > 10% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals deteriorating manufacturing activity, which pressures earnings and confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls > 2% below its 12-month MA over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces corporate borrowing, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income of more than 1% signals reduced consumer purchasing power, which lowers demand for equities and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 3.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the GDP Price Index above 0.5% signals inflationary pressure, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
